BiblicalUsage: Mosadah is a foundation. The foundations of the earth should have taught men God's ways from the beginning; the foundations of the hills move and tremble at His anger, and the strong foundations of the earth hear the LORD's controversy with His people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the foundations of the earth are God's own work. They move when He is angry, and they stand to hear His case.
